title: Awards.json precursor entry
description: Schema for the dramaLeague / outerCriticsCircle / dramadesk fields on each show in data/awards.json. Used by scripts/lib/awards-schema-validator.js to fail-loud on transcription typos. nominations integer is deprecated as of 2026-05-16 (Sprint 1 tier-weighted Awards Score) — nominatedFor.length is canonical.

season.description: Tony-season label in YYYY-YY format, e.g. '2024-25'

wins.description: Category names this show won at this precursor (any tier)

nominatedFor.description: ALL category names this show was nominated in at this precursor (any tier). Canonical — replaces deprecated `nominations` integer.

nominations.description: DEPRECATED (Sprint 1 2026-05-16). Use nominatedFor.length instead. Kept for back-compat on legacy entries.

note.description: Optional human note (e.g. OB→Broadway transfer context)

url.description: Optional Wikipedia URL of the source page for this entry

winnerNames.description: Per-award winner names for per-performer awards (e.g. Drama League 'Distinguished Performance Award'). Key = award category in wins[]. Value = array of winner names (supports ties). Used by Tony Nominations Center chip-render to attribute the chip to the actual performer rather than every acting nominee from the winning show.
